partner_types.title: Logistics & q-commerce
partner_types.body: Capacity without capex. Dedicated vehicles for your rider pool, hub-side battery swapping and maintenance SLAs — scaled up or down with your volume. This is the Delhivery model.

partner_types.title: Vehicle manufacturers
partner_types.body: Six OEMs already supply RIDEV. We buy in fleet volume, run the vehicles hard in real duty cycles, and send back failure data no showroom ever sees.

partner_types.title: Service & repair workshops
partner_types.body: Join the maintenance partner network. Raise a parts estimate against a vehicle, get it approved in the portal, do the job, upload the invoice, close it out. Every line item tracked.

partner_types.title: Hub & real-estate partners
partner_types.body: A RIDEV hub needs secure parking, power and road access. If you have space in a delivery-dense corridor in one of our cities — or in Pune or Bengaluru — we want to talk.

safety.title: Insured from day one
safety.body: Every vehicle carries insurance for the whole subscription, and RIDEV runs the claim. A crash does not become the rider's paperwork problem.

safety.title: Roadside support
safety.body: Break down mid-shift and the hub arranges recovery. You do not push a dead scooter across the city.

safety.title: Serviced, not just rented
safety.body: Brakes, tyres and electricals are checked on a schedule, not when they fail. Every job is closed against a ready-for-delivery date.

safety.title: A real human at the hub
safety.body: Eight hubs, each staffed. Riding for a living means problems happen at 11pm — there is a place to take them.

principles.v: A vehicle that is not moving is not earning — for the rider or for us. Downtime is the number we manage.
One weekly number, no surprises. Energy, repairs and insurance are ours to absorb, not the rider's to gamble on.
We own the vehicles and staff the hubs. Nothing important about the rider's day is outsourced to a marketplace.
We publish operating data with its date and source, and we do not publish numbers we cannot stand behind.

careers.body: RIDEV grows one hub at a time. We hire hub managers, EV technicians, fleet supervisors and city leads in every market we open — and engineers for the fleet platform behind it.
